newsitem.title: USA: EXECUTIVE RISK FILES FOR 1 MLN SHR OFFERING.
newsitem.headline: EXECUTIVE RISK FILES FOR 1 MLN SHR OFFERING.

text.p: Executive Risk Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an underwritten public offering of one million shares.
Executive Risk said it will use the offering's proceeds to suppert existing credit lines of its insurance company subsidiaries and to finance entry into new business lines.
The insurance holding company said it will grant underwriters Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp., Conning & Co and Oppenheimer & Co Inc an over-allotment option of 150,000 shares.
